description: This file defines a custom extension for a rich text editor (likely Tiptap) to implement a task list feature, including attributes, rendering, commands, node views, plugins for handling drop behavior, state management, input rules, and keyboard shortcuts.

classes.name: TaskListNode
classes.description: A custom extension of the TaskList node with added attributes, commands, node view, plugins, input rules, and shortcuts for task list functionality.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines custom attributes for the task list node, including stats, title, and readonly status, with HTML parsing and rendering logic.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies the HTML tag ('ul.checklist') that represents the task list in HTML.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how the task list node is rendered as HTML, adding class 'checklist'.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides a command 'toggleTaskList' to toggle the task list state with permission check and selection handling.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a custom node view for the task list with update logic based on attributes and child count.

methods.name: addProseMirrorPlugins
methods.description: Adds ProseMirror plugins for handling drop behavior and reactive state management of task list items.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines input rules to convert specific input patterns into task lists, with permission checks.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcut for toggling task list.

methods.name: eventCoords
methods.description: Utility to get mouse event coordinates.

methods.name: areAllChecked
methods.description: Checks if all child task items are checked within a node.
